spans.s:
The affix अप् comes after the verb मद् when not in composition with an उपसर्ग ।

Terms: अप्

The affix अञ् is added to the word मद्र , preceded by a word denoting 'direction', in the remaining senses.

Terms: अञ्

The affix कन् comes in the remaining senses after the words 1. मद्र and 2. वृजि।

Terms: कन्

The affix डाच् comes after the word मद्र followed by कृ 'to make' in the sense of 'to shave'.

Terms: डाच्

For the म् of the affix मत् is substituted व if the अङ्ग (stem) ends in म् or अ ( and आ) or if these are in the penultimate position; but not after यव etc.

Terms: मतुप्
